name: Italy
overview: Scripture reveals Italy as a significant location in the early Christian narrative, notably through references to the Italian band and the expulsion of Jewish believers from Rome under Claudius, as seen in the experiences of Aquila and Priscilla. The Apostle Paul’s journey to Italy, under the protection of a Roman centurion, highlights the spread of the Gospel beyond Jewish communities. Furthermore, the greetings from the saints of Italy emphasize the presence of a faithful Christian community there, underscoring Italy’s role in the broader mission of the early church.
